_comments: THE ACCESS OVERRIDE HOOK (bizapps-orders#268). The ORDERS_ACCESS_OVERRIDE task type in
metadata/task-types/ names it as its OnComplete, OnCancel and OnReject action, so a decision made in
the Tasks inbox reaches the override. The class behind it holds no override logic and is idempotent.

fields.Name: Apply Access Override Decision
fields.Description: Apply the outcome of an access override's approval task to the override: an approval makes it Approved and re-decides the order's grants; a rejection makes it Rejected; a task closed any other way withdraws it. Idempotent.
fields.UserPrompt: Apply the decision on an access override approval task.

fields.Name: TaskID
fields.Description: The approval task whose outcome to apply. Tasks passes it when the task closes.
